readme: Golden question set for retrieval. `expect` lists the concept ids that answer the question — a hit on any of them counts, so a question with two legitimate answers is not penalized for picking either. `conflict` asserts that resolving the concept surfaces dissent from the named layers, which is the thing ContextCake claims to do that a flat wiki cannot. `probes` records why the question is in the set; when a question starts passing or failing, that note is what tells you whether the change was real.

questions.question: what language should I use for a new service?
questions.probes: natural phrasing with stopwords; three layers disagree and all three must survive

questions.question: which database do we use for service state?
questions.probes: direct lexical match on a distinctive term

questions.question: what databases are we allowed to use?
questions.probes: plural form of a term the corpus writes in the singular

questions.question: where should analytics queries run?
questions.probes: team overrides the org answer; the org position must still be visible

questions.question: how do I store secrets?
questions.probes: short natural question, single strong term

questions.question: what TLS version is required?
questions.probes: acronym plus a common noun

questions.question: how long do we keep logs?
questions.probes: the doc says retained, the question says keep — no lexical overlap on the verb

questions.question: how long are customer records retained?
questions.probes: same concept as q07 with the document's own vocabulary, to isolate vocabulary effects

questions.question: when does a Sev1 page someone?
questions.probes: distinctive token that appears in exactly one document

questions.question: do we need a postmortem for a Sev2?
questions.probes: two distinctive tokens, both in the same document

questions.question: how do I get production access?
questions.probes: production also appears in deploy, observability and security docs

questions.question: how many approvals does a pull request need?
questions.probes: the corpus says change and review, never pull request

questions.question: who reviews changes to billing code?
questions.probes: reviews vs review — morphological variant of the key term

questions.question: how do I roll back a bad deploy?
questions.probes: roll back vs rollback — tokenization boundary

questions.question: can I deploy on a Friday afternoon?
questions.probes: team explicitly reverses the org rule; both answers must be present

questions.question: what are the deployment windows?
questions.probes: deployment vs deploys — morphological variant

questions.question: what metrics should my service export?
questions.probes: streaming metrics override request metrics; the org list must still show

questions.question: how should I paginate a collection endpoint?
questions.probes: paginate vs pagination — morphological variant

questions.question: how do we version breaking API changes?
questions.probes: version and breaking both appear in schema-evolution as a distractor

questions.question: why are my Spark executors getting killed?
questions.probes: executors vs executor; killed appears in the target document

questions.question: executor exit code 137 during a join
questions.probes: keyword-style query pasted from an error, no natural language

questions.question: how do we handle skewed join keys?
questions.probes: skewed vs skew — morphological variant on the decisive term

questions.question: my consumer group keeps rebalancing after a deploy
questions.probes: rebalancing vs rebalance; deploy is a strong distractor term

questions.question: how do I stop rebalance storms?
questions.probes: exact title vocabulary — should be the easiest question in the set

questions.question: how should Kafka topics be named?
questions.probes: named vs naming/names — morphological variant

questions.question: should I partition by timestamp?
questions.probes: the answer is a warning against the thing asked about

questions.question: do we use exactly-once delivery?
questions.probes: hyphenated term; tokenizer keeps hyphens so exactly-once splits differently than expected

questions.question: can I rename a field in an Avro schema?
questions.probes: rename vs renaming; field appears across many documents

questions.question: which schema changes are backward compatible?
questions.probes: compatible vs compatibility — morphological variant

questions.question: the pipeline is stalled, what do I do?
questions.probes: heavy stopword load around two content words

questions.question: consumer lag is growing overnight
questions.probes: genuinely two-answer question; either is a correct first hit

questions.question: how do I run a backfill safely?
questions.probes: distinctive term, but run appears everywhere

questions.question: can I reuse the checkpoint when reprocessing?
questions.probes: checkpoint appears in three documents; reprocessing only in the target

questions.question: how do I run the pipeline on my laptop?
questions.probes: laptop appears once; pipeline appears in six documents

questions.question: kafka advertised listener localhost problem
questions.probes: keyword query where the strongest term is in a low-priority personal note

questions.question: how do I bucket timestamps in ClickHouse?
questions.probes: timestamps vs timestamp; bucket vs bucketing/buckets

questions.question: approximate distinct count in ClickHouse
questions.probes: the document says approximate and uniq, never distinct count

questions.question: why is my ClickHouse query slow?
questions.probes: query and slow both appear in the target; ClickHouse also appears in two team docs
